formData.missionQuestion: What inspires me most is how directly Dotmatics’ platform supports scientific discovery. Bringing data and decision-making together into one system helps researchers move faster and with more confidence. Having worked in a scientific environment at Abcam, I understand how important reliable systems are, so being part of building a platform like LUMA—where quality enables real-world research impact—is something I find really motivating.
formData.describeTestQuestion: Built a Playwright test suite using Typescript to smoke test Dotmatics Website. To demonstrate abilites to create e2e tests via black box testing
